digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport / TicketTransport port
propositions: The DC writing reconcile pass fails because JiraDataCenterTransport is missing twelve members the core reaches for, all declared on no Protocol in _backend.py.

Most missing members are swallowed by enclosing exception handlers, so a DC deployment silently appears to converge while not syncing comments, links, parents, issue properties, or validating assignees; 'no AttributeError' is the wrong acceptance bar.

Each of the twelve members needs a recorded verdict (IMPLEMENT via DC REST v2 through pycontribs/jira, NotImplementedError naming the limitation, or unreachable-by-call-site), backed by call-site evidence rather than symmetry with Cloud.

set_reporter must be implemented as issue.update(fields={'reporter':{'name':...}}) and inbound_fields._identity_of must carry DC's name into account_id, otherwise the reporter mutation re-emits on every pass and breaks idempotence.

TicketTransport must be made @runtime_checkable and its members asserted at backend construction, with a structural test collecting every client/transport attribute access to prevent silent under-counting.
Newly-implemented transport members must log at WARNING naming the member and remote id, with a caplog test proving emission, since seven members have call sites that swallow exceptions everywhere.
